summary: Quarterly attestation request: redactable per-tenant audit snapshots with nonce-based resume tokens and non-deletion proof
description:
Issue summary: AlderBank (enterprise customer) requests a quarterly attestation bundle demonstrating the ability to produce redactable, per-tenant audit snapshots that are tamper-evident and include nonce-based resume tokens plus a non-deletion proof for a 3-month window.

Impact: Compliance and legal team require this artefact to meet contractual evidence obligations for an upcoming regulator review. Customer has a compliance deadline on 2026-03-20 and needs an initial delivery sample by 2026-03-16.

Requested deliverables:
- One redactable per-tenant audit snapshot (ndjson) covering 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28 with field-level allowlist applied per AlderBank mapping.
- Signed manifest (ed25519) listing per-file checksums (sha256) and an injectable nonce-based resume token schema v2 for resumption after partial replay.
- Non-deletion attestation statement: procedure and sample proof that the snapshot existed and was not deleted within the retention window (anchored checksum timestamp and KMS key id).
- Playbook snippet: steps for AlderBank to replay the snapshot into their SIEM (SumoLogic/Arcsight) including field mapping and redact policy settings.

Customer provided: mapping CSV, allowlist JSON, regulatory questionnaire indicating required evidence fields, and a preferred S3 endpoint with cross-account role for delivery.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Validate customer allowlist and mapping CSV attached on ticket.
2) Run audit export job (exporter-v2) for tenant AlderBank for date range 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28 with redactable=true.
3) Generate per-file sha256 checksums and create manifest.json.
4) Sign manifest.json with ed25519-subkey from KMS alias/account.
5) Produce resume token(s) for each batch using nonce schema v2 (nonce = HMAC_SHA256(kek, <tenant>||<batch-id>||<timestamp>)).
6) Upload artifacts to AlderBank delivery S3 with pre-signed manifest and set object-lock retention=GOVERNANCE for 30 days.
7) Provide attestation letter PDF and playbook snippet to customer and Legal.

comments: Aisha Carter (2026-03-12): Opened ticket after initial call with AlderBank legal. Customer expects an HSM-backed signature and a nonce-resume token format they can verify locally.

Marco Li (2026-03-12): Assigned. Plan: run a test export in staging, validate manifest signing against KMS alias, then run prod export with governance retention set for delivery. ETA sample by 2026-03-16.
SRE Team (2026-03-13): Noted that KMS key alias/audit-signing/2025-12 is in a rotation window. We'll create a short-lived key material for signing and provide key id and cert.
AlderBank Compliance (2026-03-13): Confirmed they will accept ed25519 signatures and will verify nonce derivation using HMAC with the provided KEK id.
Marco Li (2026-03-14): Uploaded preliminary sample to customer S3 (s3://AlderBank-delivery/attestations/sample-2026-02/) and posted playbook snippet to Confluence. Awaiting customer verification.
investigation_notes: Checked exporter-v2 codepath: redactable export flag produces per-event redaction markers and includes field_allowlist handling. Verified mapping CSV parsed without errors.

Verified KMS signing flow in staging: signer uses ed25519 key stored in HSM-backed KMS (alias/audit-signing/2025-12). Confirmed signature verifies with public key. Key marked for rotation; created ephemeral signing key sk-ephemeral-03 for production run.

Nonce resume token schema v2 implemented: token = base64(nonce||batch-id||expiry||hmac). HMAC uses KEK located at kms://alias/export-kev/ke-01. Reviewed code and verified HMAC truncation to 16 bytes as per spec - flagged to Security for discussion (truncation reduces integrity margin).

Checked object-lock retention and bucket policy for delivery S3: cross-account role ARN present and PutObject allowed with x-amz-object-lock-mode=GOVERNANCE. Noted that customer requested immutable retention but we cannot set compliance mode on cross-account uploads without their admin; documented manual step for AlderBank admin to finalize.
Ran checksum anchor with timestamping: generated anchoring record anchored to internal timestamp service (rfc3161-style) and included timestamp token id in attestation letter.

Potential blocker: Legal requested a non-deletion proof that spans 90 days; current delivery governance retention is 30 days. Proposed solution: provide notarized checksum anchor and guidance for customer to set longer retention on their side.
resolution:
Partial delivery completed 2026-03-14: sample redactable snapshot + signed manifest + nonce-resume-token examples delivered to s3://AlderBank-delivery/attestations/sample-2026-02/. Attachments include manifest.json, manifest.sig (ed25519), and README-playbook.md.

Open items / follow-up:
- Customer to confirm verification of signatures and resume tokens by 2026-03-16 (SLA).
- Legal and Security to approve HMAC truncation policy; Security contact: Priya Nair.
- For full 90-day non-deletion attestation, propose either (A) Redwood sets object-lock compliance mode on delivery bucket (requires AlderBank admin action) or (B) provide notarized anchoring service for entire 90-day window. Planned follow-up ticket to coordinate (INT-?).
